title: Dialpad vs Loom: Cloud business calling or asynchronous screen-and-camera video?
description: A decision guide for Dialpad versus Loom. Dialpad focuses on cloud business calling; Loom focuses on asynchronous screen-and-camera video. Compare the actual job, workflow, and operating requirements rather than assuming a single winner. Check current vendor documentation and plan terms before deciding.

features.tool1Detail: Evaluate Dialpad when calls, call handling, and phone-based support or sales workflows are central; verify transcription, call routing, and retention controls.
features.tool2Detail: Evaluate Loom when recorded demos and async updates can replace repeat meetings; test recording, captions, sharing permissions, and retention.

verdict: There is no verified universal winner between Dialpad and Loom: they focus on cloud business calling and asynchronous screen-and-camera video, respectively. Start with the outcome your team needs, then pilot the product that directly supports that outcome. If both jobs are required, assess whether the tools complement one another and define ownership at the handoff. Verify current features, plan limits, total cost, integrations, privacy, permissions, and support before committing.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Dialpad and Loom?
faqs.answer: Dialpad focuses on cloud business calling; Loom focuses on asynchronous screen-and-camera video. They should not be compared as interchangeable products unless your required workflow shows a genuine overlap.

faqs.question: Can Dialpad replace Loom?
faqs.answer: Only if a pilot proves that Dialpad meets the requirements you currently depend on Loom to satisfy. Check required outputs, permissions, integrations, and operational controls before switching.

faqs.question: Can a team use Dialpad and Loom together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if the team needs both cloud business calling and asynchronous screen-and-camera video. Define which product owns each step, how information moves between them, and who is responsible for access and data quality.

faqs.question: How should I compare their costs?
faqs.answer: Estimate the cost of the specific workflow you need: include seats, usage, integrations, setup, support, and ongoing administration for Dialpad and Loom. Verify current vendor pricing and plan limits rather than relying on old figures.

faqs.question: What should I test before choosing?
faqs.answer: For Dialpad, test whether it handles cloud business calling with acceptable setup and ongoing effort. For Loom, test whether it handles asynchronous screen-and-camera video. Compare both against written success criteria and review security, privacy, and support requirements.
